Some Micrel KSZ8041NL PHY chips exhibit continuous RX errors after using
the power down mode bit (0.11). If the PHY is taken out of power down
mode in a certain temperature range
column2: the PHY enters a weird state which

column1: leads to continuously reporting RX errors. In that state
able to receive or send any Ethernet frames and the activity LED is
constantly blinking. Since Linux is using the suspend callback when the
interface is taken down
column2: ending up in that state can easily happen

column1: during a normal startup.
Micrel confirmed the issue in errata DS80000700A [*]
clock recovery when using power down mode. Even the latest revision (A4
Revision ID 0x1513) seems to suffer that problem
errata is not going to be fixed.
Remove the suspend/resume callback to avoid using the power down mode
completely.
[*] https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/80000700A.pdf
